snippet.title: SAGE: Teaser Trailer (Frog Wizard Game)
snippet.description: Leap into SAGE, a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Learn magic, gather resources, befriend villagers, and sip fragrant teas with fellow adventurers.
